Michele takes care of our staff. He's a super professional, very empathetic (even with the "bosses" 😊)
He loves his job and does it with extreme passion and professionalism. And he's also friendly, which can't hurt!

Excellent! Very knowledgeable and empathetic. He loves animals and his work. I took him to see our 16-year-old cat, Charlie, who suffers from hyperthyroidism, and he prescribed an effective treatment with no side effects. We are truly fortunate to have met Dr. Bonomo. Highly recommended.
Fast and available for evidence
Professionalism and great sensitivity ♥️

Today I had the opportunity to personally meet Dr. Bonomo, a man of great professionalism and humanity, and, no less, a fantastic doctor.
I was struck by his kindness and helpfulness.
He answered my questions concretely, listening attentively.
He loves his work very much and has a great approach to his patients.
What can I say?
I'm very satisfied.
Top vet in town
The best vet ever. The entire staff is super knowledgeable, helpful, and kind.

I entrusted my dog ​​to the care of Dr. Bonomo for her entire life, from birth to her final days. For this reason, my opinion is the result of a long and, unfortunately, conflicting history.
For many years, the Doctor was an irreplaceable point of reference. I always appreciated his kindness, empathy, and constant availability, even by telephone, during emergencies. His ability to put both the animal and its owners at ease, combined with a humane and cheerful approach, made every visit peaceful.
Unfortunately, I must report a drastic and negative change in clinical management during the last year of my dog's life. I observed gross negligence in underestimating signs that would have required more in-depth diagnostic tests. The preference was to proceed with symptomatic therapies (painkillers) without investigating the underlying cause. Only later did a kidney disease emerge; unfortunately, some medications previously administered proved incompatible with this clinical picture, accelerating the deterioration.
Despite last-ditch attempts at recovery with a few IVs, the diagnostic delay was fatal. While human error is understandable, clinical precision in the medical field cannot be compromised, especially after years of monitoring the same patient.
I leave this review with a heavy heart: I feel great gratitude for the past, but immense sadness for how the story ended. I hope this criticism can serve as a warning to restore focus and scientific rigor to the center of the profession, so that others do not have to experience the same outcome.

Dr. Bonomo is an exceptional, loving, and very professional and competent person with his furry patients who adore him. He is a veterinarian we trust and entrust completely with the care of our Golden Retriever. Truly a super professional!
Our vet for years. Just one word: Top. It doesn't get any better!

We arrived after being rudely kicked out of a 24-hour clinic. We had our elderly lady in our arms... terminally ill and in the throes of a terrible crisis. A terrifying experience. That's how we found Dr. Bonomo. When they say one door closes (literally), another opens. An extraordinary person before a doctor. His love for animals comes first. And this love leads him to possess far superior medical skills than any veterinarian. He always made us feel safe, even when there wasn't much left to do.
We were lucky to have met him.
Professionalism, competence and passion for the profession 👌 …

Dr. Bonomo and his team provided exceptional care for our Belle, both medically and personally, right up until the end. Despite the sadness, he established a wonderful relationship with our entire family. Unfortunately, it's impossible to rate it higher than five stars. Thank you.
Good, patient and a great animal lover
Knowledgeable, competent, helpful, and empathetic. His responses are always timely and precise.
Dr. Bonomo is certainly one of the best veterinarians in Milan.
Highly recommended! Always available and kind.

Dr Michele is a very kind and nice both person and doctor!
We went to him with Pati, this morning, on a very rainy day. He was very patient and it’s so obvious he loves animals so much.

Happy we have found him as Pati’s vet.

Michele Bonomo, our veterinarian, has been our vet for many years, and he's the best in my opinion!! He's truly experienced, and you can immediately see that he loves all animals and his work!
The best!!

Before being an excellent veterinarian, he's an animal lover. He's been caring for our Golden Retriever since she was a puppy, and I'm extremely satisfied with the entire team. They're always kind and helpful, as well as competent.
I've never seen a vet so in love with his job. A colleague of mine travels across Milan to bring her two cats here.
Very friendly and professional 👍 …
Dr. Bonomo has been our dog doctor for over 20 years and is a fantastic professional and person. Attentive, meticulous, and helpful.
Truly competent and helpful, we've been very happy ever since we started working with him. Thank you, Doctor. Thea
I take my two cats to Dr. Michele and I'm very satisfied. He's very knowledgeable and always available to help and advise, even over the phone if needed. Highly recommended.

Professional, competent, and helpful, he gave me excellent advice for my cat.
I would recommend him to friends.
The best vet in the world! Period
I can only say: professional and meticulous. He had the best possible approach with my newly adopted dog: even though she's generally afraid of everything, as soon as she sees him, she wags her tail!
